newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Jan-Feb car sales at 13,905 units.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Jan-Feb car sales at 13,905 units.

text.p: Philippine car sales in the first two months of the year reached 13,905 units, down from 14,555 units sold in the same period last year, the Chamber of Automotive Manufacturers of the Philippines Inc said on Monday.
An industry group official said a slowdown in car sales was experienced especially in January following the sharp increase in sales in December last year.
Car firms undertook aggressive Christmas promotions.
Figures from the car industry group showed January sales were at 6,292 units and February at 7,613 units.
For the first two months, the car sales were led by the unit of Japan's Honda Motor Co Ltd with 2,536 units.
The other leading car firms were the units of Mitsubishi Motors Corp with 2,496 cars; Toyota Motor Co, 2,370; and Nissan Motor Co Ltd, 2,218.
